settings.title: Data Strategy & Big Data Consulting
settings.text:
We help you turn scattered sales, inventory and customer data into a clear data strategy that supports everyday decisions and long‑term growth.

From choosing the right tools to defining the KPIs that matter, we design a practical roadmap so your data actually serves your business helping you enter new markets, cut waste and run leaner, more profitable operations.​​

Outcomes: Clear data vision, defined metrics, aligned stakeholders, better‑focused investments.

settings.title: Data Analytics
settings.text:
We analyse your POS, ecommerce, booking and campaign data to surface the patterns you can’t see in spreadsheets.

Our team helps you decide which data streams to track, builds reports around revenue, margin, stock health and customer behaviour, and turns them into specific recommendations you can act on today, whether through a one‑off audit or an ongoing partnership.​​

Outcomes: Visibility on what’s driving growth or leakage, prioritised actions, measurable impact.

settings.title: Data Infrastructure & Engineering
settings.text:
It’s not enough to collect data; it has to be organised and accessible. We help you design or improve the data plumbing behind your retail or service business; how data moves from POS, inventory tools, websites and apps into one reliable source of truth.

That includes choosing the right stack, cleaning and structuring data, and making sure teams know how to use it.​

Outcomes: Reliable, centralised data; less manual work; better foundations for analytics and reporting.

settings.title: Data Visualization & Dashboards
settings.text:
We transform complex data into dashboards your founders, store managers and teams can read in minutes.

Our visualisations highlight the metrics that matter; revenue, margin, stock risk, utilisation, new vs returning customers so you can spot trends, explain them to stakeholders and decide what to do next at a glance.​

Outcomes: Clear, shared view of performance; faster decisions; easier communication with teams and investors.
